description: This file defines the BlockReferenceExpression class, which represents a block call node within the Twig templating engine's node structure. It provides methods to compile and render block references in templates, managing different call types like yield, render, or block existence checks.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\BlockReferenceExpression
classes.description: Represents a block call node in Twig templates, handling different types of block references such as yield, render, or existence test, and compiling them into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with the block name, optional template, and line number, issuing a deprecation warning if the name isn't an AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code based on whether it is a 'defined test', 'output', or default render, producing code to yield, render, or load the block template.

methods.name: compileTemplateCall
methods.description: Generates PHP code to call a specific method ('hasBlock', 'yieldBlock', 'renderBlock') on the template, loading the template if provided.

methods.name: compileBlockArguments
methods.description: Outputs the arguments for the block call, including the block name, context, and optionally blocks, preparing parameters for the method call.
